plan.rationale: Dispatching two drones to the highest-risk URM-infill and steel blocks south of the helicopter's current path, where the model predicts up to 65% probability of complete destruction across buildings housing over 15,000 people. D1 will survey the One Sansome Street block, while D2 assesses the 32 Battery Street block—which AIR 1 could not see—and nearby unscanned blocks at 50 Fremont Center and the PG&E Building. D3 is held in reserve for follow-up on new collapses or trapped survivors.

plan.rationale: With helicopter scanning complete and this being our final wave, we are deploying all three drones to resolve critical life-safety gaps. Drone 1 will verify trapped survivors at California Bank and Trust and resolve high-occupancy damage disagreements along California and Pine Streets. Drones 2 and 3 will sweep high-risk unscanned blocks in SoMa and the Financial District—including the Rincon Annex, 50 Fremont Center, and the unassessed 475 Sansome Street block—leaving no drones in reserve.
